motion_scope: Only process covariance changes. Original measurement noise, initialization, thresholds and buffer25 are retained. Real replay asserts the shared prediction filter is restored after every frame.
matching_scope: Changed motion states can change geometric costs and assignments. This experiment does not lock baseline primary assignments.
counter_scope: Train_calibrated_motion_update_frames counts activations, not correct associations. Inherited primary-hook counters are unused and do not measure motion-induced assignment changes.
runtime_scope: CPU cache replay excludes image IO, RGB/IR encoders, detector and offline IR generation; not end-to-end FPS.
